description: This Java source file defines the Receiver class, a Spring component that acts as a command-line client for receiving messages via Hono's telemetry and event APIs. It manages connection establishment, consumer creation for different message types, and message handling logic.

classes.name: Receiver
classes.description: A Spring component class that implements a message receiver for Hono's telemetry and event APIs, managing connection setup and message consumption.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the receiver by connecting to Hono and setting up message consumers.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Creates message consumers for telemetry and/or event messages based on the configured message type.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming messages, extracting device ID and payload, and logging details.

methods.name: handleCreateConsumerStatus
methods.description: Handles the result of consumer creation, logging success or failure.
